surface: The pagination bar: the page size select and the page buttons, the page each button announces, and the focus a disabled button hands on.

steps.note: Tab leaves the last cell of the first row for the bar's first control, the page size select, which holds 10. The scenario starts on the page (`start: page`): the page's first item is the `Input top` field, not the grid. VoiceOver with WebKit said nothing on this first key, as on the first key of other scenarios.
On the first page the first and previous page buttons are disabled, so Tab skips them to the next page button.
Enter turns the page, and the plugin announces it (`Page 2 of 10`, assertive). The focus stays on the button.

Enter goes to the last page, which disables the next and last page buttons, so the plugin hands the focus to the previous page button. A reader says the page and the button the focus landed on. Finding: VoiceOver says only the page, not the button: WebKit on every run, Chromium on some.
Enter on the previous page button.
Off the first page, the first page button is enabled and comes before the previous one.

Enter goes back to the first page, which disables the first and previous page buttons, so the focus moves to the next page button. Finding: VoiceOver with WebKit says only the page, not the button, as on the last page.
Shift+Tab skips the two disabled buttons back to the page size select.
Shift+Tab goes back into the grid, on the cell it left (`United Kingdom`, the last cell of the first row).
